audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues. mid already contains the right idea — 'bait his W early: if he burns [the] cleanse on your Solar Snare he has nothing to remove the next root' — but never gives the number that makes it a plan.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14. Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9. At rank 1 Mel's root comes back exactly twice as fast as his cleanse, so the second root inside a 22-second window is guaranteed to stick. That is the whole matchup expressed as two numbers, and it is the single most actionable line available here.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1 against an 11s Solar Snare — bait one root, land the second.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places tell Mel to reflect his barrels: spikes[1].text 'Rebuttal eats his barrel chain and his Q poke and fires the projectile back', wants.you[1] 'Hold Rebuttal for his barrel-poke or Q', and full dosFull[1].t 'Reflect Powder Kegs (Barrels) back the moment he commits'.
audit.why: Powder Keg is a placed zone — the kit flags it slow and zone with no projectile. The detonation is an area explosion, not something Rebuttal can return. Parrrley is the projectile, and it is also what lights the keg, so the reflect window is his 625-range Q, not the blast. Telling a player to hold a 38-second cooldown for the wrong half of his pattern wastes the ability every time.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal reflects Parrrley; the keg blast is a zone, so the reflect window is his 625-range Q.
sources: champ-data/_kits/gangplank.json (E flags slow/zone, Q flags projectile)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text and whys[4] both claim 'Cannon Barrage (R) ranks up his barrel scaling'.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is a separate ability — Riot's text is 'Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies'. Powder Keg damage ranks with Powder Keg, not with his ultimate. Ranking R changes his map pressure and its 160/140/120 cooldown, and a Mel who expects her lane opponent's barrels to jump in damage at 6 will misprice the level-6 trade in both directions.
audit.corrected: At 6 he gains a 160s global bombardment; his barrel damage tracks Powder Keg's own rank.
sources: champ-data/_kits/gangplank.json (R and E descriptions, R cd 160/140/120)

audit.whatIsWrong: mid calls Gangplank's cleanse 'Rebuttal-cleanse' — 'if he burns Rebuttal-cleanse on your Solar Snare'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is Mel's own W. Gangplank's cleanse is Remove Scurvy. The sentence hands Mel's ability name to her opponent in the one line that matters most in this lane, and the name-check tooling did not catch it because Rebuttal is a legitimate name inside this file.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.trading and report[3].t both say a spent Rebuttal is gone 'for twenty seconds'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 — 38s at rank 1, nearly double the figure quoted, against a Parrrley that returns every 4.5s.

58.33% over 12 games with the content chart giving Mel levels 1-2, skill at 3 and Gangplank everything from 4 onward is a coherent read: Mel out-ranges a melee farm pattern early and loses to crit scaling plus a global ultimate. Left alone.

notes: This entry was already one of the stronger ones — it had the bait-the-cleanse idea before I got here. Three real errors underneath it: (1) it called Gangplank's cleanse 'Rebuttal-cleanse', which is Mel's own W name, in the single most important sentence of the matchup; (2) it told Mel to reflect his barrels, but Powder Keg is a placed zone with no projectile flag — Parrrley is the reflectable half of his pattern; (3) it claimed Cannon Barrage 'ranks up his barrel scaling', which is not how either ability works. The one number this matchup lives on — Remove Scurvy 22s at rank 1 versus Solar Snare 11s — was nowhere in either layer and is now in four places. Left alone: 'Solar Snare's ~1.5s root' in whys[1], since the root duration is not on disk anywhere. Full-layer verdict fields remain uncorrectable through the applier (shared boilerplate, exactly-once rule).
